AlsoOn.description: One entry of a card's `also_on`: a tagged member of its group (with `id`) or a derived link.

at.description: For a derived link, a time that belongs to it (an archived copy's capture).

derived.description: A link nobody tagged, found by a source: never fetched, counted or ranked.

id.description: A tagged member's resource ID; absent on a derived link.

kind.description: For a derived link, a qualifier (`archived`).

site.description: The service: a member's site as its card names it, a derived link's service name.

via.description: For a derived link: the hub or service it came through (`musicbrainz`, `wikidata`).

Card.description:
The one card every route returns for a resource, occurrence or reference event. Absent
values are null, never "".

also_on.description:
The same thing elsewhere: the other members of its group (tagged links, with their ID),
then derived links nobody tagged (`derived: true`), by service name; one per music service
and at most 8 on a card, up to 256 on `GET /v1/resources/{id}`, whose `details.also_on`
lists every link. A hint: every member keeps its own card.

attribution.description:
OpenStreetMap cards, events placed at an OSM venue and events whose zone was derived from
coordinates: the ODbL attribution to display with the card.

description.description: Plain text, entity-decoded: escape it before rendering it as HTML.

oneOf.description: For a Nexus event reference: the reference this card is.

maybe_same.description:
On an event card: up to three other events that are possibly the same one, best first
(the rule: "Possibly the same event" in docs/api.md). A hint only: never a group, never counted, and never a member of this card's own group.
Absent on other cards, and everywhere when `[event] same_event_hint = "off"`.

name.description: Plain text, entity-decoded: escape it before rendering it as HTML.

oneOf.description: For a calendar occurrence: which feed instance this card is.

site.description:
The publishing site: the host, or the app for `pubky://` objects (e.g. `mapky.app`).
Plain text, like every text field.

ChangeLine.description:
One change: which resource (and occurrence) changed, when, how and in which fields. Clients
read the current facts from the resource itself.

root.description: For an `aliased` line: the root that answers for this resource from now on.

since.description: Inclusive lower bound on the change time, as a string or as Unix milliseconds

oneOf.description: RFC 3339, Unix milliseconds as text, or relative to the request: now, now-Nd, now-Nh, now+Nd or now+Nh (the current minute); a later page keeps the first page's window

uris.description: Links, read as `POST /v1/resources/lookup` reads them; an unknown link adds nothing.

aliases.description:
Other spellings of this link that resolve to it (its aliases), by URI, at most 50. A
page's own claims (`url`, `@id`, `sameAs`, canonical links) are not aliases and are not
listed.

also_on.description:
Every link of `also_on`, all of them: each tagged member and each derived link, several of
one music service too (the card's `also_on` shows one per music service).

facts.description:
The fields that API names for the object, and the facts the also-on sources read for it
(`isrc`, `upc`, `mbid`, `artist`, `duration`), by name; several values are joined with
"; ". Absent when there are none.

from.description:
Where the card's metadata came from when it is not the page itself: the official API
that answered (docs/sources).

maybe_same.description:
On an event card: up to ten events that are possibly the same one, best first (the card's
`maybe_same` is the first three).

Facets.description: The facets `facet` asked for, over the whole filtered set.

tags.description: `facet=tags`: the labels the filtered links carry, most frequent first.

type.description: `facet=type`: the card types of the filtered set, most frequent first.

GroupDetail.description:
`GET /v1/groups/{id}`: what joined the group and every member's own card. A group is a hint
that the members are one thing on several services; nothing about them is merged.

keys.description: The identifiers two or more members share (`cite:…`, `ics_feed:…`, `ics_uid:…`).

members.description: Every member's card, by ID and then member key.

type.description: The type most members have (ties by name).

GroupRef.description:
The group this card is in (its other members are in `also_on`). Nothing is merged; every
member keeps its own card.

size.description: Members in the group, this one included.

Info.description:
What a client needs: the version, what this instance resolves, the limits a client must
respect, and the licence of the OSM-derived values its cards carry.

resolves.description: The kinds of links this instance resolves: its routes and card kinds that are on.

change_lookup.description: Resource IDs or URIs in one `POST /v1/changes/lookup`.

occurrence_lookup.description: Feed IDs or URIs in one `POST /v1/occurrences/lookup`.

previews_per_minute.description: `POST /v1/resolve` requests per minute per client address, and per URI.

requests_per_minute.description: Requests per minute per client address, every public route together.

search_page.description: The largest `limit` of one search page.

feed_uri.description:
The feed's URI: the link people tagged. To combine with Nexus, send this, not the card's
own `uri` (the occurrence's URL, which nobody tagged).

status.description:
The instance's lifecycle: `scheduled`, `cancelled`, `postponed`, `rescheduled` or
`moved_online`. The card's own `status` is the feed's fetch health.

cursor.description: Signed keyset cursor, scoped to these feeds and window; invalid after restart.

from.description:
Inclusive start time (RFC 3339); defaults to the earliest accepted horizon start of these
feeds.

resource_ids.description:
Feed resource IDs; with `uris`, 1–500 together. An alias reads its root, an unknown ID
adds nothing.

uris.description: Feed links, read as `POST /v1/resources/lookup` reads them; an unknown link adds nothing.

items.description: One card per occurrence, with `occurrence` naming the feed instance and its lifecycle.

OsmDumpLine.description: A dump line: the notice first, then one place per line.

OsmDumpNotice.description: First line of the OSM dump: the ODbL notice.

OsmDumpPlace.description:
One cached OSM object per line after the notice; every field is present, null where unknown.
The projection is explicit (`OSM_DUMP_LINE`): internal columns never reach the dump.

versions.description:
Every derived document served publicly, keyed by the version hash that change entries
and pinned resource documents name.

dump.description: The share-alike download: the ODbL derivative database as a daily file.

updated_at.description: When the file was last written; `null` before the first.

ResourceDetail.description: `GET /v1/resources/{id}` and `/v1/resolve`: the card plus the resource's details.

SameEvent.description:
Another event that is possibly the same one: it starts together with this one, near it (or,
when either has no place, at the same venue or under the same organizer), under a similar
name, on another page.

id.description: Its card's ID (a feed's, for an occurrence).

score.description: How alike the two names are, from 0.5 to 1 (pg_trgm similarity of the normalised names).

uri.description:
Its page: the occurrence's own page, or the feed's or event's link (for a feed read from a
service's API, that service's page).

info.description: Pinakes ranks, Nexus hydrates. External resource metadata and search. Every operation carries examples named by their values, covering every kind of card and source; pick one in a dropdown and use Try it out.
info.title: Pinakes

200.description: The ODbL derivative database, written daily, as a gzip file download. Decompressed it is one JSON object per line: the licence notice first (`OsmDumpNotice`), then one cached OSM object per line (`OsmDumpPlace`). Single byte ranges are served (206)

206.description: The requested byte range of the file

429.description: Over `limits.osm_dump_downloads_per_hour` transfers (200 or 206) to this address in the last hour; HEAD, 304 and 416 are free

503.description: No dump file written yet; retry later

get.description: The version, what this instance resolves and the limits a client must respect. The same path on admin_listen has the operator detail.

post.description: The calendar instances of several feeds in one time-ordered page: by start, then feed, UID and recurrence ID. Each card's `id` is its feed. The window and limits are those of `GET /v1/resources/{id}/occurrences`; unknown IDs add nothing.

400.description: 1–500 valid IDs, a valid window, limit or cursor

parameters.description: The link as referenced: normalised like every URI, and an alias answers with its root.
parameters.name: uri

get.summary:
One link's card by its URI, as `POST /v1/resources/lookup` answers for it: a link Pinakes
does not know is a 404 and is not fetched (`POST /v1/resolve` resolves it).

400.description: Exactly one list of 1–500 IDs or URIs

get.description: Calendar instances ordered by start, UID and recurrence ID. Inclusive window, default limit 100, maximum 500. Superseded keys are omitted.

parameters.description: Inclusive start time; defaults to this feed's last accepted horizon start.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Signed keyset cursor, scoped to this resource and window; invalid after restart.
parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Examples: pick the example in the dropdown of each parameter it uses; the other parameters stay (none) and are not sent.

parameters.description:
Links carrying one exact identifier, on any service and in any spelling:
`mbid:{uuid}` (a MusicBrainz recording, release, release group or artist),
`wikidata:{Q-id}`, `isrc:{code}` or `upc:{barcode}`.
parameters.name: key

parameters.description:
With `sort=trending`: how far back references count, `1h`–`90d` (`{n}h` or `{n}d`),
default `7d`.
parameters.name: window

parameters.description: Authenticated opaque keyset cursor from this daemon; invalid after restart. Restart pagination on HTTP 400.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Counts over the whole filtered set: `tags` (labels), `type` (card types) or both
(`type,tags`); `collapse` changes the rows, not the counts.
parameters.name: facet

parameters.description: West,south,east,north in degrees; west > east crosses the antimeridian.
parameters.name: bbox

parameters.description: Latitude,longitude in degrees; requires radius and excludes bbox.
parameters.name: near

parameters.description: Positive metres, at most the configured maximum (200000 by default).
parameters.name: radius

parameters.description:
Inclusive start time lower bound: RFC3339, Unix milliseconds, or relative to the request
(`now`, `now+7d`, `now-12h`; the current minute).
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Inclusive start time upper bound: RFC3339, Unix milliseconds, or relative (`now+30d`).
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Finite map zoom; fractional zooms are floored and clamped to the table. Requires bbox; large views coarsen to the configured cell budget.
parameters.name: cluster

parameters.description: Resource ID of the accepted event venue; filters event units.
parameters.name: venue

parameters.description:
A list view with one row per group: the matching member with the most references, as its
own card; links in no group stay rows of their own. Not with `cluster`.
parameters.name: collapse

tags.description: Link previews and cards: resolve a pasted link, look up the cards of a page of posts, open one card.
tags.name: Previews

tags.description: Map viewports, nearby places, events, tag pages, the search box and social reach.
tags.name: Search

tags.description: Links to the same thing on several services: a hint on each card, never a merge.
tags.name: Groups

tags.description: Freshness: what changed for the links a client keeps.
tags.name: Changes
